Nephesh, originally breath, (a) refers predominantly to the emotional life; (b) is a strong personal or reflexive pronoun; or (c¢) is equivalent to person. Ruach. originally ind, indicates also especially, 206 (2) supernatural influences acting on man from without ; (Ὁ) the normal breath-soul, the principle of life (like nephesh) or of its energies, directly derived from the wind at the bidding of God; (c) the resultant psychical life, like mepkesh, heart’, the inner life in general.
